preconditions.description: The dimensions n and m are integers between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= w_ij <= 10**9 for row in w_rows for w_ij in row)
preconditions.description: Every element in the input matrix w is a non-negative integer not exceeding 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len(w_rows) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in w_rows)
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n rows, each with exactly m integers.

postconditions.expression: if not is_valid: stdout == 'NO\n' else stdout.startswith('YES\n')
postconditions.description: If no valid solution exists, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by the solution parameters.
The modulus k must be a positive integer within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: if is_valid: all(0 <= a_i <= 10**18 for a_i in a_list) and all(0 <= b_j <= 10**18 for b_j in b_list)
postconditions.description: The arrays a and b must contain non-negative integers within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: if is_valid: all(w_rows[i][j] == (a_list[i] + b_list[j]) % k for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: Every element w[i][j] in the matrix must equal (a[i] + b[j]) modulo k.

postconditions.expression: if is_valid: all(w_rows[i][j] < k for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: Every element in the matrix w must be strictly less than k.

postconditions.expression: if is_valid: len(a_list) == n and len(b_list) == m
postconditions.description: The output arrays a and b must have lengths n and m respectively.
